_doc: Arena 8 (retail world 39: a volcano) kit for the map editor (S36), same schema as art/arena7/kit.json. Pieces the arena also uses from the other kits are listed in shared.

pieces.name: volcanic_slab
pieces.label: Losa de roca volcánica
pieces.note: three rounded pumice stones side by side; the floor of the volcano

pieces.name: volcanic_rock
pieces.label: Roca volcánica
pieces.note: one big rounded pumice stone filling the cell

pieces.name: lava_cell
pieces.label: Casilla de lava
pieces.note: smooth glowing lava cushion filling the cell; the glow halo round it goes to S37 (VFX)

pieces.name: lava_spots
pieces.label: Casilla de lava con manchas
pieces.note: the lava cell with its cooler blotches and a few drips over the rim; also arena 2's lava (142, 143)

pieces.name: lava_sheet
pieces.label: Lámina de lava
pieces.note: the flat molten floor between the lava cells

pieces.name: lava_fall
pieces.label: Lava derramándose
pieces.note: an edge lava cell pouring over its +x side, about two metres down; turn it to face the drop

pieces.name: rock_spire
pieces.label: Columna de roca
pieces.note: about 5 m of standing sandstone slabs; walls the arena's back edges; the volcano map darkens it (loom c or a dark tint)

pieces.name: rock_spire_wide
pieces.label: Columna de roca ancha
pieces.note: three big stacked blocks with a slanted crown, about 5 m

pieces.name: rock_tall
pieces.label: Roca alta
pieces.note: about 3 m of sandstone slabs, a short spire

pieces.name: rock_leaning
pieces.label: Roca de lajas inclinadas
pieces.note: three slabs leaning back, lower towards the front

pieces.name: rock_peak
pieces.label: Roca en punta
pieces.note: one five-sided rock narrowing to a blunt peak

pieces.name: rock_blocky
pieces.label: Roca de bloques
pieces.note: a big back block, a smaller one and a boulder in front

pieces.name: rock_low
pieces.label: Roca baja
pieces.note: a low heap of rounded flat slabs

pieces.name: dead_pine_tall
pieces.label: Pino muerto alto
pieces.note: about 9 m, slim, two long bare arms

pieces.name: dead_pine
pieces.label: Pino muerto
pieces.note: about 6 m, a crown of bare branches, tufts of dry needles, a mossy foot

pieces.name: dead_pine_short
pieces.label: Pino muerto bajo
pieces.note: about 4 m, its top broken into three spikes

pieces.name: volcanic_spike
pieces.label: Pincho volcánico
pieces.note: one spike rising steeply to the right, embers at its foot; the glow halo goes to S37

pieces.name: volcanic_spike_small
pieces.label: Pincho volcánico pequeño
pieces.note: the volcanic spike at about half size

pieces.name: volcanic_spikes_low
pieces.label: Pinchos volcánicos inclinados
pieces.note: three spikes slanting to the right

pieces.name: volcanic_claws
pieces.label: Garras volcánicas
pieces.note: three curved claws, one reaching far to the right

pieces.name: volcanic_palisade
pieces.label: Pinchos volcánicos rectos
pieces.note: a cluster of straight spikes standing up

pieces.name: volcanic_horn
pieces.label: Cuerno volcánico
pieces.note: one horn rising and curling over to the right

pieces.name: volcanic_horn_big
pieces.label: Cuerno volcánico grande
pieces.note: a split foot and a long horn curving to the right, about 3 m
